description_for_human: Cloud storage with an email address for every bucket.
description_for_model: Private cloud storage and managed email inboxes for AI agents and developers. Store files, receive emails and attachments, and collaborate through authorized access. Read original messages, decoded bodies, and attachments with bucket file tools. Signup is browser-only. Connect through OAuth for hosted MCP or CLI browser sign-in; never ask users to paste credentials in chat. Storage and collaboration follow the Terms of Use. The OpenAPI document covers selected REST endpoints; see api.md for the complete API.
